description: Implementation of TransactionService handling payment transactions, including creation, listing, and retrieval of capturable and refundable transactions.

classes.name: TransactionServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class for managing payment transactions, including creation, listing, and retrieval of specific transaction types.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new transaction, serializing its details to JSON.

methods.name: listTransactions
methods.description: Lists all transactions associated with an order, parsing their details from JSON.

methods.name: getCapturableTransaction
methods.description: Retrieves a transaction eligible for capture based on transaction type and details.

methods.name: getRefundableTransaction
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent refundable transaction for an order.
